_meta.note: Prior 60-record checkpoint skipped candidate 381, and used 726 as its 60th research record despite 726 being filtered source position 61. We independently reconciled all archived batches and the 92 retained source candidates. Each new unique candidate is counted once. No published site changes. Source claims versus official physical facility facts are separate.

records.access: Free customer cinema parking is not permission for on-site sexual use or all-night public access. No specific parking-space map.
records.duplicates: No indication same physical site as other Bologna venues (Montagnola, Pontelungo) in this research selection.
corrections: Earlier audit queue had mistakenly omitted this retained candidate; now completed.
No independently documented recent physical cruising; statements about busy times not supported.
Cinema parking capacity/availability cannot be derived from theatre screening hours.

records.name: A45 Westerfilde / Kirchlinde (both directions)
records.disposition: Retain but map BOTH stop directions distinctly
records.identity: Westerfilde (Ost, toward Dortmund) 51.536992,7.369944; Kirchlinde (West, toward Aschaffenburg) 51.536357,7.368555. Stored coordinates pin Westerfilde only; Kirchlinde is a distinct vehicle entrance. Autobahn-data guides confirm separated named stops with different capacities.

recent_evidence.details: Forum suggests some former Lusebrink traffic shifted to these stops, unverified and no count.

records.access: Current third-party traffic status lists both stops as 'eingeschränkt' (restricted) with restrooms; these status fields vary and do not prove full closure or cruising. Enter from signed A45 direction and do not cross motorway.
records.duplicates: Two independently named motorway sides are one historical source entry but not a single shared driving pin; keep site-specific access separately identifiable. Lusebrink is another site and should not be merged just because source users report moving.
corrections: Clarify that 51.536992,7.369944 applies only to Westerfilde; include separate Kirchlinde coordinates in research metadata.
2026 forum claim about growth is an anecdote, not witnessed multiple confirmed encounters.
Traffic restrictions can change; no permanently closed assertion.

records.name: Technische Universität Dortmund
records.disposition: Retain only as recent question and historical changed conditions; highly uncertain ongoing use
records.identity: Original gay-szene entry refers to some WC in Emil-Figge-Straße 50, but 2013/2018 comments conflict on floor and renovations, so actual source WC is not established. University current *gender-neutral public toilet directory* lists a DIFFERENT facility on fourth floor between D/E and a ground floor AStA WC. These current facilities cannot be assumed to be the old cruising spot, or described as cruising places. Stored coords 51.49454,7.41706 generic building point.

recent_evidence.details: Old claimed cubicle feature removed in renovation.

records.access: Uni Emil-Figge-Straße 50 is active campus venue. Official Oct 27 2026 municipal notice scheduled street full-closure for 5–6 Nov only; no evidence it persists Nov 8. Tender for 2027–29 staged EF50 renovation is future work, NOT current building closure. University access hours vary; official student workspace hours Mon–Fri 06:30–21:30, Sat/Sun 08:30–16:00, not restroom hours or sex permit.
records.duplicates: Cannot join historic first-floor/wing D-E WC to new gender-neutral toilets solely by common location. Do not publish current accessible gender-neutral WC details as substitute cruising directions.
corrections: Important: currently operating university toilet directory does NOT verify old cruising WC and cannot be used to support sexual-activity location.
Avoid falsely claiming 5–6 Nov road closure on 8 Nov without fresh verification.
No current positive firsthand cruising evidence.
